name: CLIENT_ID
label: Clever app client ID
help: Users connect by signing in with Clever. The sign-in only proves who they are; their data is read with the district's own token below.
setupSteps: In the Clever developer dashboard, open your district app's Settings.
Add the redirect URI below to the app's OAuth redirect URIs.
Copy the app's client ID and client secret here.

name: CLEVER_DISTRICT_TOKENS
label: District tokens
help: A JSON object mapping each Clever district ID to that district's district-app bearer token, e.g. {"5f…": "token"}. Every read and gradebook change is made with it, scoped to what the signed-in user may reach; agents never see it. Assignments and grades need Clever LMS Connect, which Clever offers under a Clever Complete agreement.
